Who thrives here

Read the Darrow Creed

  • Put people first.

    You build for humans, not use cases. Trust and dignity are non-negotiable starting points.

  • Own every conversation.

    You communicate with clarity and intention. You listen to understand, not to respond.

  • Pursue justice together.

    You act with urgency for the people depending on your work. Their clarity and confidence is the measure of yours.

  • Live Truthfully.

    You say the hard thing You align your actions with your words and own your mistakes.

  • Embrace radical foresight.

    You seek hidden patterns, welcome bold ideas, and aren't satisfied with how things are done today.

“We build our products with a culture of radical ownership. If you find a friction point, you’re encouraged to dive in and solve it, no matter how “set in stone” the assumptions seem. It’s a masterclass in agency, and the right balance between teamwork and individual excellence.”

VP Product

“The problems we work on at Darrow are genuinely interesting. You’re combining law, AI, and complex engineering challenges to understand how the legal system actually functions. That kind of challenge is rare - and incredibly motivating.”

Data Science Lead

How We Work

Darrowers are interdisciplinary to the core. Legal thinkers, AI engineers, data scientists, and intelligence analysts work in close formation - not in silos.  The people who build the systems are in constant dialogue with the people  who understand the legal environments those systems are designed to decode.

We practice intentional communication: listening carefully, speaking clearly,  and welcoming disagreement in the service of better outcomes. Rigorous debate and collaboration aren't in tension here: they are the same thing.

What We Offer

We design our workplaces to support both excellence and well-being, because the best work comes from the people who are challenged and cared for in equal measure.
